title: Zero-gravity bonding of ceramic to metal with human DNA, used in medical implants

tellings.quote: And then they figured out in zero gravity how to to bond ceramic to metal. And then they were able to put human DNA into the ceramic.

plain: Scientists are said to have learned, in the zero gravity of space, how to bond ceramic to metal and then put human DNA into the ceramic, a technique the story says ended up in medical implants. Chris Bledsoe, a man the episode says NASA studies because he claims to attract UFOs, tells Michels this as something he was told by someone else. If true, it would mean advanced materials work from space quietly made its way into medicine.
